bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the causal effect of gender on outcomes by applying Counterfactual Fairness-CLOseness Testing (CF-CLOT) to measure the distributional closeness of factual and counterfactual predictions in student performance, academic dropout, and obesity estimation datasets.
Applying CF-CLOT to test for causal fairness using parents' occupation and educational qualifications as sensitive attributes in student performance and dropout datasets.

Intervening on age groups and using CF-CLOT to compute the Norm-Adaptive Maximum Mean Discrepancy Treatment Effect (N-TE) to detect unfairness in obesity estimation and credit risk assessment datasets.
Treating negative emotion labels (Disgust, Fear, Sad, Angry) as sensitive attributes in a Facial Expression Recognition (FER) task and evaluating causal fairness disparities using CF-CLOT.
